title: Per-tenant and per-route cost guidance engine with safe-apply and rollback sandbox
creator: Marco Reyes
description: Build a guidance engine and safe-apply runtime that produces per-customer and per-route batching/caching recommendations, enforces segmentation via allowlists/denylists, and supports tier-aware policy controls. The work includes: (1) a recommendation engine that suggests safe batching and KV-prefix caching profiles based on historical telemetry, (2) per-tenant and per-route policy evaluation with segmentation trees and explicit allow/deny lists, and (3) a SafeApply sandbox that runs dry-runs, creates configuration snapshots, and supports automated rollback with audit logs. The goal is to reduce per-token unit cost for customers while preserving latency SLOs and preventing unsafe global config changes.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation engine computes per-route suggestions and exposes top-3 safe profiles with expected cost/latency delta
SafeApply can run a dry-run simulation against a real traffic mirror and produce telemetry-driven risk score
Config apply requires either canary flag or automated rollback snapshot; manual rollback via console within 15 minutes
Segmentation supports: tenant-level, route-level, and tier-level policy precedence with allowlist/denylist enforcement
Audit logs capture actor, delta, simulation results, and rollback events for every SafeApply
End-to-end e2e test demonstrating 15% reduction in token cost for a sample tier without crossing latency SLO
implementation_steps: Design: finalize policy model (precedence rules, match keys, scope) - link design doc
Data: add telemetry export for token-level cost, seqlen histogram, per-route latency percentiles
Engine: implement heuristic recommendation service that ingests 30d telemetry and outputs candidate profiles
Policy Eval: implement fast route/tenant matcher and allowlist/denylist checks in routing layer
SafeApply: implement dry-run sandbox that mirrors traffic and computes risk score; store snapshot in config store
UI/Console: expose recommendations, simulation results, and one-click safe-apply with canary controls
Rollout: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on SLA breach or regression alerts
Tests: unit, integration, and a staged load test using the synthetic traffic harness
monitoring_and_metrics: Latency P50/P95/P99 per route and per tier
KV cache hit rate and effective token reduction
Recommend-to-apply conversion rate and rollback frequency
Risk score distribution for applied configs
Incidents triggered by SafeApply and time-to-rollback
rollout_plan: Internal alpha: enable for internal tenants only + synthetic traffic mirror
Beta customers: opt-in for 3 pilot customers across three tiers
Gradual production rollout with canary percentage gates and automated regression detection
Post-rollout audit review and retro after 2 weeks of 100% traffic
rollback_plan: Automatic rollback trigger if latency SLO breach or error-rate increase > 2x baseline
Manual rollback from Console: select snapshot -> revert -> validate via smoke tests
All rollbacks emit audit entry and create follow-up incident card
SafeApply retains last 5 snapshots per tenant for point-in-time restores
risks_and_mitigation: Over-aggressive batching could add tail latency: mitigate with conservative default profiles and latency-aware cost scoring
Incorrect allowlist rules may block critical routes: require staged dry-run and explicit owner approval for denylist writes
Telemetry gaps could bias recommendations: add health checks and fallback to safe defaults
Privilege escalation via Console: require RBAC check and MFA for apply to high-impact tenants
Unintended cross-tenant effects: ensure per-tenant namespace isolation in config store and runtime enforcement
